title: 模造の楽園と、断片の鏡
author: 群青 リク

en.title: The Imitation Paradise and the Fragmented Mirror
en.premise: Rumors speak of a "desert oasis" lush with vibrant greenery that suddenly appears in the gaps between skyscrapers and the cracks of the asphalt. Is it a mere hallucination, or a physical singularity? A student seeking escape, a detective chasing an anomaly, and an old man involved in the city's design—three lives that touched a "mirror-like" phenomenon from different paths now converge upon the city's blank zone.

zh.title: 模造乐园与碎片之镜
zh.premise: 摩天大楼的缝隙间、沥青路面的裂缝中，流传着一个突如其现的传闻——那是充满苍翠绿意的“沙漠绿洲”。它是幻觉，还是某种物理奇点？寻求逃避的学生、追寻违和感的刑警，以及曾参与都市设计的 वृद्ध（老人）。在不同地点触及“镜子”般现象的三人，其命运正向着都市的空白地带汇聚收敛。
